option_relations.rationale: Chronic cutaneous lupus erythematosus (CCLE) is a broader term that encompasses several subtypes, but no matching leaf ID is found.
Cutaneous lupus erythematosus is a broader term that includes subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus.
Periorbital Discoid Lupus Erythematosus (DLE) is a specific subtype, but no matching leaf ID is found.
Subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus is a specific diagnosis that matches the leaf ID B4.2.
